`highlight.min.js` is highlight.js 11.11.1 (BSD-3-Clause, https://highlightjs.org), common
languages, followed by its dockerfile, cmake, dart, protobuf, gradle and latex modules. Each file
came from cdnjs and matched the sha256 of the npm package @highlightjs/cdn-assets@11.11.1 on
jsDelivr. The colours are the app's own, in ../style.css.
